newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian capital Riga gets BBB- rating from S&P.
newsitem.headline: Latvian capital Riga gets BBB- rating from S&P.

text.p: Latvian capital Riga said on Wednesday it has been awarded a BBB- credit rating by Standard & Poors with the outlook positive to receive an upgrade within one to three years.

S&P awarded Riga a BBB- rating in January but the Latvian capital asked the agency to review it. It said it wanted the same rating as S&P gave to Latvia, which has an invest grade sovereign rating of BBB.

"Standard and Poors repeated its rating and Riga was awarded the same BBB- rating while the outlook is now changed to positive from stable," Inga Cerbule, city finance department deputy director for investment credit questions, told Reuters. -- Martinsh Gravitis, Riga newsroom, +371 721 5240
